description: A pan has landed on the window days: each knob it was carrying (start, end) moves onto that edge, pushing the other if they'd cross.

cases.name: the start knob pulled onto the new left edge
the end knob pulled onto the new right edge
a pulled start knob pushes an end knob before it
a pulled start knob drags an end knob left behind
a pulled end knob drags a start knob ahead of it
